# Copilot Instructions

## Coding Style
- Use camelCase for variable and function names
- Use meaningful, descriptive names (avoid abbreviations)
- Follow Allman-style brackets

## C++ Guidelines
- Prefer modern C++ features (C++17/20/23 where applicable)
- Use smart pointers instead of raw pointers
- Favor standard library solutions over custom implementations

## Programming Style
- Favor functional programming concepts where possible
- Prefer declarative style over imperative solutions
- Write clean, readable, and maintainable code

## General
- Keep functions small and focused
- Avoid unnecessary complexity
- Write self-explanatory code with minimal comments
